question: What Is the EtherNet/IP Protocol and CIP?
body_html:
EtherNet/IP is an industrial Ethernet protocol that carries CIP (Common Industrial Protocol) over standard TCP/IP and UDP/IP. The IP stands for Industrial Protocol, and it is managed by ODVA.

ItemDetail
Explicit messagingTCP port 44818, client and server
Implicit messagingUDP port 2222, cyclic I/O data
CIP addressClass / Instance / Attribute
Same CIP layerDeviceNet and ControlNet

Devices are described by EDS files and device profiles so products from different vendors interoperate.
